source_snapshot.procedure: Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, filter TEMP_INTEL_NIC, inspect BMC Web and retain anomalies.
source_snapshot.criteria: Names/descriptions/readings in both lists and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 27.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but invents a title sensor, truncates OOB-only evidence and omits adapter/BDF/port identity and Web.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires every Intel adapter/port mapping, full five-view evidence and numbering disposition.

old_problem: A server may contain multiple Intel NICs with similar labels but different serials, slots, BDFs, ports, firmware and thermal conditions. The source does not say whether TEMP_INTEL_NIC is per-adapter, per-port or aggregate, and the criteria numbering jumps from 2 to 27.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by requiring a Project-owned Intel NIC inventory and per-record crosswalk rather than an engineering decision about concrete runtime identities. ED-02 preserves this row/variant, ED-03 permits runtime bindings, ED-05 keeps this Ethernet scope distinct from IB, ED-08 preserves Web visuals and ED-15 prevents invented limits. No NIC stress or failover is implied.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2023, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2024 / Wistron-BMC-01044-V002 / b1eec76c5aae2229.
Every Intel NIC must be identified by model/PN/serial, PCIe slot/BDF, port, firmware and driver so one adapter cannot satisfy another.
Complete untruncated IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists and every Web row establish the TEMP_INTEL_NIC population; grep is not a completeness oracle.
Passive PCIe link, Ethernet link and workload context may accompany temperature evidence, but this sensor row authorizes no traffic stress, failover, link flap, reset or configuration write.
Criteria 1, 2 and 27 remain as written; criteria 3-26 are not invented.
No ipmitool, PCIe/NIC query, authentication, Web capture, network action, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Per-adapter Intel NIC thermal-sensor five-view reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify every required Intel NIC thermal sensor is attributed to the correct adapter serial, slot/BDF and port and reports SPEC-consistent fields across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
required_package: SUT/BMC identity and complete Intel NIC model/PN/serial/firmware/driver/slot/BDF/port inventory
Approved TEMP_INTEL_NIC population and per-adapter five-view sensor crosswalk
Versioned units/range/state/threshold/freshness/unavailable rules and passive PCIe/link/workload/airflow context
Approved ipmitool plus protected IB/OOB/Web access and retained logs
NIC/BMC owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; freeze the Intel NIC inventory and bind every expected thermal record to serial, PCIe slot/BDF and port. Preserve logs. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs before filtering TEMP_INTEL_NIC, every relevant Web page, and passive PCIe/Ethernet link plus workload/airflow context. Compare population and fields against the approved map/SPEC. Do not use the title as a sensor, truncate, stress traffic, flap links, reset an adapter, write configuration/thresholds, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved Intel NIC sensor appears exactly once for the correct adapter/port and has fresh, SPEC-valid, mutually consistent identity/value/unit/state/threshold data in all five views, without new link, PCIe or thermal faults.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete adapter inventory/crosswalk and full five-view evidence meeting approved rules. FAIL on wrong adapter/BDF/port attribution, missing/extra/duplicate/stale record, cross-view mismatch, exceeded approved limit or new link/PCIe/thermal fault. Missing mapping or limits is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no NIC traffic stress, failover, link flap, reset, firmware/configuration or threshold write.
Protect credentials and retain complete raw inventories before filtering.
Stop on ambiguous adapter identity, link degradation, PCIe errors, missing/duplicate/stale data or thermal alarm.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve the first discrepancy and context.
expected_evidence: Complete Intel NIC serial/firmware/driver/slot/BDF/port inventory and sensor crosswalk
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web evidence for every adapter
Per-adapter comparison with passive PCIe/link/workload/airflow/error context
Numbering defect and no-stress/no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit plus engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target/mapping, access failure, missing or mismatched telemetry, link degradation, PCIe error or thermal alarm, stop passive collection and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not reset or reconfigure the NIC, clear logs or retry; escalate the exact serial/BDF/port and sensor record.

source_conflict.reason: A complete serial/slot/BDF/port inventory and per-adapter crosswalk resolve generic INTEL_NIC scope without treating one filtered record as all adapters; numbering is editorial.

blocked.reason: Safe passive semantics, evidence and recovery are defined; concrete adapter identities/maps and limits are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Intel NIC serial/slot/BDF/port inventory, TEMP_INTEL_NIC population/crosswalk, approved limits/freshness and passive link/workload context.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO PER-ADAPTER PASSIVE SENSOR RECONCILIATION; NO IPMITOOL, NIC/PCIE QUERY, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, LINK/RESET/STRESS ACTION, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: ipmitool sensor-list implementation
external_authorities.application: Supports passive SDR-backed reads but not OEM NIC-to-sensor mapping.

external_authorities.title: PCI sysfs ABI documentation
external_authorities.application: Supports read-only BDF identity evidence; it does not define BMC sensor naming or acceptance limits.
